claims.evidence: The capacity stamp is not visible in the provided photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturing or expiry date stamped on the handle or shroud.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than LPG.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp or a gas type label on the handle.

risks.risk: The valve may be leaking or the threads may be damaged.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve threads.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the stamped markings on the handle or shroud showing the weight (kg) and the expiry date.
Photo of the valve with a soap bubble test to check for leaks.
Photo of the bottom of the cylinder to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
